info.title: Regime Card: market regime and risk-on / risk-off API
info.summary: A market regime and market risk check for AI agents. Pay per call in USDC over x402, or connect the MCP server. No account, no API key.
info.description: Is the US market risk-on or risk-off right now? Regime Card reads eight cross-asset signals (credit, volatility, rates, currencies, commodities, sectors) and answers with one reading from 0 to 100 and one of five market regimes, from Risk-Off to Risk-On. Agents use it as a market conditions check, a macro signal, or a risk check before a trade. Also: the stress gate, and how a stock or crypto has typically done in markets like today's. Pay per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana over x402. No account, no API key. Each settled regime reading is added to a public, hash-linked record the day it is published; a correction is a new entry, never an edit.
info.x-guidance: Regime Card describes US market conditions: a percentile from 0 (most risk-off) to 100 (most risk-on), one of five regimes, a stress gate, and how stocks and coins have typically done in the current regime. Start with the free sample. Paid calls cost a few cents in USDC over x402 and return data only after the payment settles. Every response says whether it is live or settled. It describes conditions and is not investment advice.

get.description: Which stocks are drifting after earnings right now? Returns the Regime Card post-earnings drift (PEAD) tracker: large US stocks that reported earnings in about the last two weeks, in the tracker's own order, each with its report date, its earnings surprise, its first-session reaction and its price drift since the report. $0.02 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Rescanned each morning before the US open; prices refresh in rotation while the US market is open. "stale" is true until the current session's rescan has completed. Useful when an agent needs an earnings surprise check, post-earnings announcement drift data or an earnings calendar follow-up for stocks.
